scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF peer comparison by tracing which implementation actually parses, writes, converts, models, and renders each result; refine the existing composed comparator checkpoint without adding per-slice validation cost.

method.kind: Primary-source repository README, manual, release-note, and dependency-route review with local plan reconciliation
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: S8/PAR-07 peer-provenance and composed semantic gates
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing cross-peer independence and undxf/uncad reviews
method.limitations: Repository main/master documentation is mutable and includes project self-descriptions; source commits and package checksums were not resolved for every candidate. Dependency lineage is based on the named repositories' own documentation. No implementation claim was tested against a drawing or runtime.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG operation and class maturity are multidimensional
evidence.observed: LibreDWG's project docs identify distinct stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled class states; its tool documentation gives different DWG-to-DXF and DXF-to-DWG coverage and version limits. A project-level percentage cannot certify one file, direction, version, class, or complete output.
doesNotEstablish: behavior of a pinned binary on the local source-authored profile
complete typed preservation from a successful conversion status
that current mutable branch documentation exactly describes released 0.14.1
evidence.planUse: Pin release/commit and build flags, record direction and version, and compare per-handle typed/raw/ignored/derived/refused disposition rather than aggregate coverage claims.

evidence.topic: Application consumers sharing ACadRust are correlated codec evidence
evidence.observed: ACadRust's own README lists OpenCADStudio as a consumer of its engine. App-level rendering/modeling can provide a distinct downstream observation, but an application self-round-trip routed through the same engine is not an independent parser or writer implementation. ACadRust's mutable feature claims are not bound in this review to a package checksum or immutable source revision.
doesNotEstablish: released artifact support for every README feature/version
independence of OpenCADStudio codec read/write from ACadRust
B-rep correctness from displayed geometry or same-engine self-readback
evidence.planUse: Record app and engine identities separately; use an application only for its downstream consumer stage and pin both app release and exact engine revision.

evidence.topic: dwg-rs is independent but currently structural/alpha evidence
evidence.observed: The project describes itself as a pre-alpha ODA-spec-derived reader. Its README marks per-entity decoders partial/alpha, the DWG writer alpha without automated external-CAD acceptance, and DXF parsing not implemented; the section and raw-object traversal layer is more mature than semantic 3D processing.
doesNotEstablish: DWG/DXF semantic parity for the full local matrix
DXF parsing or output round-trip correctness
3D solid or native CAD acceptance from approximate glTF output
evidence.planUse: Retain only an optional, version-pinned structural DWG cross-check for container/section/record boundaries already in its evidenced scope.

evidence.topic: uncad is a composed wrapper, not a new DWG lineage
evidence.observed: The uncad README states that DWG parsing uses LibreDWG FFI, DXF parsing uses the separate undxf crate, and output is read-only JSON/SVG/PNG. Its DWG path therefore shares LibreDWG lineage; only the pinned undxf dependency can provide a separate DXF parser path.
doesNotEstablish: an independent DWG parser or writer
independent codec evidence from JSON or renderer output
evidence.planUse: Exclude uncad from DWG peer counts; optionally route the exact undxf parser through the existing composed DXF comparison after lockfile/crate pinning.

evidence.topic: Independent parser, application, and semantic stages must be scored separately
evidence.observed: LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ezdxf, dwg-rs, ACadRust, and undxf implement different format, operation, and maturity slices. A wrapper or GUI can contribute a distinct renderer/importer observation only when that stage is separately identified; it cannot create independent codec evidence by product branding.
doesNotEstablish: that any peer is a universal oracle
that parsing or writing implies consumer acceptance
that opaque payload preservation implies editable geometry semantics
evidence.planUse: At the already-composed checkpoint capture immutable artifact, parser/writer/converter/kernel/renderer dependencies, direction/version/encoding, fallback settings, identity disposition, and independent expected geometry where relevant.

readinessRefinement: count evidence by the actual parser/writer lineage, not the application or wrapper name
separate parser, serialization, conversion, kernel/modeler, renderer, and native acceptance results
restrict dwg-rs to optional structural comparisons until its documented alpha gates advance
treat uncad's DWG route as LibreDWG-derived and its DXF route as undxf-derived after exact dependency pinning
keep peer execution at the existing composed checkpoint; do not add per-slice dependency or runtime work
